speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: AMEOs also conduct checks on active mobility devices to ensure that the devices meet the requirements stipulated by LTA and have not been illegally modified.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: If necessary, LTA will deploy AMEOs to tackle egregious active mobility offences at these locations.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: Ultimately, path safety is a collective responsibility and we urge all users to play their part to use our shared spaces in a responsible manner.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: Works, such as the NSC, are right in the residential areas in central Singapore, such as Thomson Road and so forth.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: Not anybody's fault, but it poses a lot of challenges for both LTA and the residents.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: My grassroots and I meet very regularly with the LTA team.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: And I know they are trying really hard, but I think they will need a lot more resources to be dedicated to address a lot of these issues that happen.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: Things like the narrow pathways, where there are errant PMD riders and errant contractors who proceeded with noisy works even beyond the agreed hours.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: I feel so much that the LTA team needs a lot more support.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: I am, therefore, asking for MOT to direct more resources to support these staff, for a win-win for both the residents and the staff.

speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
text: We really seek the public's understanding during this period.

speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
text: We will deploy necessary resources to manage this, but as the Member knows, the NSC is a huge project, spanning from the northern part of Singapore to downtown.

speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
text: So, we will have to manage our resources properly.

speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
text: At this point, I would like to also take this opportunity to urge all path users, both pedestrians and active mobility riders, to really take note and, especially in crowded places, in narrow spaces, to look out for one another, slow down and play a part to ensure that our common spaces, our shared spaces, are being used safely by everybody.
